interface.shortDescription: Scientific figures with native tools or configurable providers.
interface.longDescription: Upstream PaperVizAgent roles, configurable model providers, and native Codex defaults with optional overrides.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $papervizagent with separate native agents to turn the supplied methods and caption into a scientific figure, retrieve references, and run the critic/regeneration loop.

papervizagent_config.description: Optional path to shared PaperVizAgent JSON/YAML model and pipeline configuration.

codex_oauth_token.description: Optional externally supplied Codex OAuth access token. Existing Codex sign-in is used when omitted.

codex_account_id.description: Optional account ID for an external token whose JWT does not contain it.

openai_api_key.description: Optional OpenAI API key, separate from Codex OAuth.
